parsed.reason: Description A says the removed mark_as_failure call means the conversion error is no longer stored in the result backend, so clients never see the failure. Description B says that after the ETA conversion error the handler does not return, so the task falls through and executes immediately ignoring its ETA; it also mentions the failure is never stored in the result backend. The core defect in B is the missing return/fall-through causing immediate execution, which A does not mention. A's root cause is the lost result-backend recording, which B only mentions as a secondary point. They identify different primary failures at the same location.
